currentPage.description: Current 1-based page number to render. Consumers supply a new value after loading data.

totalPages.description: Total page count — omit for unbounded mode

pages.description: Pre-computed list of page items: [{type: 'page', page: N} | {type: 'ellipsis'}]. Compute server-side with Django's Paginator.

items.description: Page item — { type: 'page', page } or { type: 'ellipsis' }.

react.description: React computes page items from currentPage and totalPages.

unbounded.description: True when total pages is unknown — hides the disabled state on Next

react.description: React infers this from the absence of totalPages.

arrowsOnly.description: Show only the prev/next arrows, no page number buttons

prevLabel.description: Label for the previous arrow link

nextLabel.description: Label for the next arrow link

hideLinkText.description: Visually hide prev/next labels (still readable by screen readers)

pageUrlPrefix.description: Optional URL or fragment prefix appended with the page number, e.g. '?page=' or '#page-'. The browser follows these links without Pagination JavaScript; the application must provide the target page or element and render the active page state. Omit for literal '#' placeholders handled by consumer code.

pageSize.description: Current page size to render. Consumers supply a new value after loading data.

onPageChange.description: React-only callback for client-side page navigation.

django.description: Django renders links; the host handles navigation.

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the navigation element
